title: Dynamics 365 Sales: run multiple Sales Qualification Agents in one environment
summary: Hold: the stop-agent row incorrectly reports that automation is undocumented. Microsoft's Dataverse reference documents updating the agent profile to Off through the Web API. The roadmap facts and the cited admin routes are supported, including the stop route through its linked settings instructions.

claims.claim: Automation for switching an agent off is not yet documented.
claims.quote: `SetState`Event: True | `PATCH` /msdyn_salesagentprofiles(msdyn_salesagentprofileid) Update the `statecode` and `statuscode` properties. | 3 | Label: **Off**State:0TransitionData: None |
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api null with kind rest, call 'PATCH /msdyn_salesagentprofiles(<msdyn_salesagentprofileid>)', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/msdyn_salesagentprofile'. Add to its note: 'The request body sets statecode to 0 (Inactive) and statuscode to 3 (Off).' Cite that reference in sources. This documents the Off state, not a guarantee of immediately halting in-flight outreach; retain the existing stop-behaviour conflict warning.
